name: HubSpot Custom Object Schema Drift Detector (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-custom-object-schema-drift-detector
**dhRobin Systems** · Scheduled governance audit: expected master template (versioned URL, env JSON or fixture) vs actual HubSpot custom object schemas and standard object properties → deletions, type mutations, required-flag changes, option removals, missing associations, unmanaged properties and objects → **critical / warning / info** → Slack governance report with links to property settings → run summary webhook → audit.

**Read-only.** The workflow never changes HubSpot.
**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` (synthetic schemas, zero API calls), `DRY_RUN=true`, `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=false`.

### Severity
- **critical**: object or property deleted/archived, type changed, enum option removed, required flag removed, association missing
- **warning**: field type, unique flag, primary display, new required field, hidden option, unmanaged object, locked-object additions, unmanaged volume, unreadable object
- **info**: labels, new options, unmanaged properties, extra associations
Override any rule with `SEVERITY_OVERRIDES`.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned: template URL fetch, custom object schemas, standard object properties, Slack, run summary webhook.
Pins apply to **manual executions only**. Unpin a node before a manual live test.

nodes.name: Governance Audit Schedule
nodes.notes: Weekdays 05:40 UTC. For a weekly audit use 40 5 * * 1.

assignments.name: config.templateInline
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = String($env.EXPECTED_SCHEMA_TEMPLATE_JSON ?? '').trim(); if (!t) return null; try { const j = JSON.parse(t); return j && typeof j === 'object' && !Array.isArray(j) ? j : { __invalid: true }; } catch (e) { return { __invalid: true }; } })() }}

assignments.name: config.severityOverrides
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = String($env.SEVERITY_OVERRIDES ?? '').trim(); if (!t) return null; try { const j = JSON.parse(t); return j && typeof j === 'object' && !Array.isArray(j) ? j : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } })() }}

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret configuration under config.*. Flags record only whether a secret or URL is set.

return $('Load Expected Template').first().json.standardObjects.map((objectType) => ({ json: { objectType } }));
